description: Intro (Enter through the pages) -> sign-in list is already full (10 factory default players ship in AE000.DAT) -> Enter on 'Start New Game' triggers the list-full dialog -> dismiss it -> Enter again selects the first player row -> 'y' confirms 'Remove A Player's Name' -> Enter selects the now-open 'Start New Game' row -> type a 4-letter name ('Test') -> Enter confirms -> Enter accepts the default 'Explorer' difficulty -> proceeds into the map and first level, dismissing the two new-user tutorial dialogs. Exercises: full-list detection, delete-confirm, name entry (auto-uppercase first letter), difficulty pick, and the map/level hand-off, all with no crash or bad rendering observed.
